'''''T-39''''' was a [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], ''T-39'', along with ''[[T-37]]'' and ''[[T-38]]'', carried wounded survivors of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Evacuation of Gelgelar|attack]] on the [[Hormuuz]] facility near [[Gelgelar/Legends|Gelgelar]] to the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']].
